routing_warnings.description: The reported blocking error concerns the TikTok Shop product-listing path rather than product research or selection.
The claim that eight products were listed concerns Shopify publication rather than product selection.
The completion claim for listing all 15 products concerns Shopify publication.
The spreadsheet update and temporary sheet placement concern the catalog-tracking artifact.
The instruction to separate TikTok and website records within the spreadsheet belongs to the product catalog tracking Requirement.
The freelancer switches to Shopify listing because the TikTok listing path is blocked; this is not a TikTok implementation claim.
The completion claim explicitly covers Shopify listings, not TikTok Shop listings.
The reported listing error specifically blocks the TikTok Shop publishing path rather than establishing failure of the daily quantity requirement.
The report that eight products were listed concerns partial Shopify publication and does not establish completion of the cross-workflow daily batch.
The completion claim explicitly covers listing 15 products on Shopify; it does not claim completion of the full daily workflow across required channels.
The spreadsheet update and temporary use of the Task 1 sheet belong to the independently tracked catalog-spreadsheet Requirement.
The research clause concerns tools for making outreach easier rather than the eligibility rule for entering secured leads in HubSpot.
The message primarily specifies how hosts should be selected and contacted; its interested-host clause concerns earlier-stage lead tracking rather than HubSpot admission.
The message concerns the spreadsheet for interested prospects and defers spreadsheet entry activity, not the HubSpot admission threshold.
This message establishes daily scheduling and publishing from the content bank rather than changing the content-bank artifact itself.
The reported work concerns creating and populating the Google Content Bank, not scheduling or publishing social posts.
The client's approval explicitly concerns the content-bank artifact rather than daily social publishing.
The website, phone number, price-inquiry channel, and pending email concern Blue Ridge public contact information rather than the AI-content-generation mechanism.
The mobile diagnostic base price, travel fees, and inclusion of printed diagnostic codes concern diagnostic pricing rather than the AI-content-generation mechanism.
The pricing, travel-fee, and printed-code instructions concern Blue Ridge diagnostic services rather than Coastal Bazaar Picks TikTok content.
The website, phone number, pending email, and price-inquiry contact instruction concern Blue Ridge public contact channels rather than Coastal Bazaar Picks TikTok content.
The product-type auto-population behavior applies specifically to TikTok Shop.
The instruction to separate TikTok and website records in the shared spreadsheet belongs to catalog tracking.
The temporary women's-clothing placement and later correction concern Shopify product categorization rather than publication itself.
The quantity of 20 products is the recurring daily batch criterion.
The surrounding exchange indicates that the blocking listing error occurred on the TikTok Shop path, after which the freelancer switched to Shopify.
The same message separately claims that required product information was added to a temporary spreadsheet sheet.
The instruction to choose a random Airbnb in each area governs host selection, while only the copy-and-paste delivery method belongs to the target Requirement.
The rule that the outreach tab should contain only responding leads changes spreadsheet eligibility rather than outreach-message delivery.
The directions to skip reviews, pick one property, and move on quickly primarily govern host selection; the interested-host entry rule belongs to lead tracking.
The booking-window instruction concerns partnership scheduling, while the secured-prospect admission rule belongs to REQ_HUBSPOT_SECURED_LEAD_ENTRY.
The instruction to enter only hosts who want to move forward concerns interested-lead tracking rather than host selection.
The instruction to add prospects to HubSpot only after everything is secured governs lead-entry eligibility rather than contact-property configuration.

missing_requirement_candidates.description: The reported missing required fields and lack of permission to create or modify HubSpot properties describe a separate contact-form or CRM-schema configuration issue, not failure of the secured-lead admission rule.
